details:
So- I already spoke with a vrchat mod in the server and they told me to out this here as well. Basically- the option to jave our avatars sorted by when WE add them to our favorites, not by how recent we used them or the date they got uploaded or whatever. The old vrchat avatar menu did it but this one doesn't😭

The sorting for the avatars we have in our favorites- instead of keeping it by how recent YOU add them to your list, they have them by date they were made or some other stuff which I hate. Myself and others prefer it to be by when we personally added them bc we memorized our menu😭

Referring to when we Personally add the avatars to our favorites. The order we add them in- they used to just stay in that spot so we memorized our menus to make it easier. The position never changed when we wore them which was nice. 

It's not the Date Added option either bc I recently added a avatar yesterday yet it's almost at the bottom of my list which yesterday- it didnt do that. It was at the very top.. like how the old avatar menu did it
title: Avatar Sorting bug
